document.about: Owens Corning ProCat accessory list. Each product has a field list ruled between its rows, with no rule over the first or under the last.

notes: The first and last rows are closed only by the ends of the column rule, which fell short of a grid line against the page's ruling; one list was welded to the table below it.

Leading columns bold on every row beside values bold on none make a list of fields.
